newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end feebly, 'tankan' impact limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end feebly, 'tankan' impact limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended on a feeble tone on Wednesday, due mostly to profit-taking after the Nikkei average had risen for three straight sessions, brokers said.
The impact of the Bank of Japan's "tankan" business sentiment survey released in the morning was limited, they added.
The Nikkei 225 ended down 72.97 points or 0.34 percent at 21,345.28. Its December futures were down 40 points at 21,320.

"The BOJ's tankan survey was within expectations," a broker at a foreign securities house said. "Bellwether shares such as Honda and Toyota Motor have been surging lately, and profit-taking was inevitable."
